summary: Alterity Therapeutics, a clinical-stage biotech, filed a Form 6-K solely to announce the submission of its Annual Report on Form 20-F with audited financials for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, plus XBRL data. The filing is a routine annual report notice containing no transactional terms, deal mechanics, or special-situation event. It references ongoing clinical development of lead asset ATH434 for Multiple System Atrophy but includes no acquisition, restructuring, capital return, or other special category. As a routine current report, this does not qualify as a special situation; category is None.
